label: Aturia-inspired smooth involute fossil shell
concept_interpretation: Viewed actual original three-view pixels. Broad inflated shell, small umbilical dimple, restrained shallow spiral and rounded rim, lower-right terminal lip. Sheet shows narrower edge than requested; preserve authored thickness 0.105 nominal rather than infer dimensions from pixels. Fossil mottling is artistic; use restrained palette patches rather than texture.
hidden_surfaces: Rear carries compatible shallow dimple and winding seam; fully closed rounded edge and fossilized terminal region. No soft tissues, exposed chambers, or asserted original pigmentation.
revision_change: Narrower shallower umbilical depression and continuous wider shallow winding groove. More radial samples resolve specific dotted groove artifact in r001, within fixed budgets.
